clue.text: Root that sounds ready for change

the boxer's name taken as it is

clue.text: One of those mail order drinks that bring out the beast in one?

parts.note: total scorn, with 'so to speak' hinting that the scorn is spoken out loud as well as absolute

the young born to an animal at one time

parts.note: relating to restricting what one eats

a period of time
